object_description: fragmented urban island around a wooded collective heart
design_condition: The proposal reinforces the site's perimeter with housing and a school while placing parking at the low point along the road, preserving a wooded collective heart and adapting built plateaus to the slope.

positive.statement: The urban-island concept creates a vast tree-filled collective heart and fragmented built fronts at the scale of the surrounding district.

position.target: collective heart and fragmented built fronts
position.rationale: Central open heart and discontinuous perimeter fronts are legible across the plan and elevations.

positive.statement: The clearly positioned soft-mobility network anchors the project in a larger scope and creates a new green multifunctional centrality.

position.rationale: Central landscape zone and perimeter connections provide the most plausible anchor for the mobility network.

positive.statement: The school opens onto the park with a covered courtyard that facilitates management of the children.

position.rationale: The courtyard is approximated at the school-facing edge of the central open space.

positive.statement: The parking is skillfully inserted into the topography and its presence is reduced as much as possible.

position.rationale: A low peripheral surface along the road is used for the approximate parking location.

positive.statement: The shallow building depth offers numerous typological potentials and high quality of use, particularly in terms of light.

position.rationale: Thin massing is evident in the elevations and distributed across the perimeter building fabric.

positive.statement: The diversity of landscape environments results from the relationship between peripheral functions and building identities rather than being forced.

position.rationale: Peripheral open-space pockets are distributed around the fragmented built perimeter.

positive.statement: The proposal is a real sewing and valorization operation of the existing through landscape programs open to different uses and favourable to flora and fauna.

position.rationale: The marker spans an existing-looking peripheral landscape band connected to the central heart.

positive.statement: The project pays great attention to open-space quality by integrating open-air water-management systems.

position.rationale: Water-management elements are approximated near the likely low peripheral landscape zone.

positive.statement: The distribution of the program makes the different operators and programs independent, allowing great operational flexibility.

position.rationale: A peripheral building region represents distributed operators and separated program areas.

positive.statement: The school can be built in a first phase while maintaining much of the existing parking and plane trees.

position.rationale: The school is approximated along the park-facing perimeter where phased construction can coexist with open areas.

positive.statement: The compact school opens onto the park with a covered courtyard that will probably become the main entrance.

position.target: school covered courtyard and main entrance
position.rationale: A park-facing central-edge zone provides the most plausible courtyard and entrance anchor.

positive.statement: Each level is organized around a generous central collective space with overhead and side light and a shared landing.

position.target: central collective space and shared landing
position.rationale: A central void-like area is visible in plan and vertically constrained through the elevations.

positive.statement: The distribution on either side of the central space offers great flexibility for classroom allocation.

position.rationale: The marker sits on one side of the visible central space, representing paired classroom allocation zones.

positive.statement: The constructive concept is consistent, with a collective distributive core and classroom construction arranged around it.

position.target: collective distributive core and classroom construction
position.rationale: The central plan feature and surrounding repetitive bays support a core-and-classroom system reading.

positive.statement: The treatment of changing rooms and glazed doors shows great care and concern in the architectural devices.

position.rationale: An entrance-facing lower facade surface is used because these small devices are not separately identifiable.

positive.statement: Solar protection by roof overhangs and projections ensures the comfort of the schoolchildren.

position.rationale: Roof-edge projections are visible along the upper perimeter in plan and elevations.

negative.statement: The street entrance does not offer sufficient clearance and should not become the main entrance.

position.rationale: The entrance is approximated on the road-facing perimeter facade, where clearance is being judged.
